answer: Surprise duty draws: at random moments the chain assigns each identity a unique verification job, such as re-checking a block, that must be done within ten minutes. Missing two draws in a row freezes its rewards. A lone agent handles this easily, but one operator running 500 sybils must keep 500 full workers live around the clock, like stacking timber that never stops burning. Draws are seeded by a public violet beacon, so no one sees the next one coming over the horizon.
